en: {player}! You won Flannery's Badge? That makes four! You're getting really good, you know.
I've just been in the herb shop. Anyway, take these. I picked them up for you.
Those are Go-Goggles. With them on, the sandstorm in the desert on Route 111 won't get in your eyes.
With four Badges, you should go and battle your dad in Petalburg too! I'm heading back to help mine. Bye!
I found an Egg, but I'm too old to carry it about until it hatches. Would you take it?
Walk plenty with it, and it will hatch in no time. Look after it, won't you?
Oh, your team is full. Come back when you have room for it.
Very well. I'll keep it warm a while longer.
Every so often an Egg turns up at the Day Care. That's where that one came from, I expect.
